chapter: Tatum, Wiggins and Los Angeles friends
title: Tatum trio venues: Royal Room, Suzy Q and Streets of Paris
summary: They work out the Hollywood Boulevard clubs where Callender played, including a night with Big Sid Catlett.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Where did the Tatum trio that you were in work here in Los Angeles?
Well, we worked at the Royal Room...

And Las Palmas. Benny Carter had a band across the street, didn't he. There was another place across the street from there... Well, it doesn't matter, except that we used to run over there during intermission and listen to Benny Carter's band.
Was that the Suzy Q? Or where was the Suzy Q? No, that was someplace...
We worked at the Suzy Q with Tatum, too.
The Suzy Q was on Hollywood Boulevard. And we worked somewhere else on Hollywood Boulevard with Tatum.
Streets of Paris? That was on Hollywood Boulevard.

The Streets of Paris, it seems to me, was before this time. Because I remember working in the Streets of Paris the one time I got to work with Big Sid Catlett, and Marlowe...oh, the piano player whose name I can't remember... Marlowe Morris. Do you remember that name?
